propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return complete copies of os.environ directly or nested in fixture arguments, exposing arbitrary ambient credentials when pytest default long traceback renders fixture arguments via saferepr on assertion failure

Pytest long traceback serialization of fixture arguments/locals leaks ambient secrets (confirmed via synthetic sentinel insertion and traceback inspection), while short traceback and code-path replacement do not reproduce the leak
All 42 affected behavior tests pass under minimal parent environment (PATH only plus explicit allowlist), proving no dependency on arbitrary ambient inheritance
Each of the seven fixtures must be modified to return only an explicit allowlisted mapping containing required PATH, state directories, and fixture-specific variables instead of dict(os.environ)
Reintroduction of dict(os.environ) at any fixture surface returns the security oracle test_fixture_env_repr_security.py to RED state, validating the fix prevents the root cause
